coverage.evidence: Settings drawer opens from the Settings button (dashboard/src/views/dashboard/media-share/MediaShareView.vue:130-138,189-197). The switches and numbers are in the page's order (components/MediaShareSettings.vue:52-58,109-124). The labels are in i18n/en.json config block. Defaults are off/on/on/on/180/null cost/20/60 (server/src/NomNomzBot.Domain/MediaShare/Entities/MediaShareConfig.cs:29-49). The minimum of 1 for duration and queue is enforced at MediaShareService.cs:471-480. Save and Discard work on a draft (MediaShareSettings.vue:87-98,147-152). Required overlays links to OBS (components/MediaSharePlayer.vue:224, obs i18n en.json:40).

Approve, reject, skip, reorder and played routes are in server/src/NomNomzBot.Api/Controllers/V1/MediaShareController.cs:92-156. Approve appends at max+1 (MediaShareService.cs:227-228,540-548). Reject moves the item to rejected with a refund unless it was played or skipped (MediaShareService.cs:254-262). Skip refunds (MediaShareService.cs:282-285). Reorder renumbers from 1 (MediaShareService.cs:319-326). Sections are pending, approved and history, and empty ones are hidden (queueSections.ts:17,37-44). Remove in the dialog sends reject (MediaShareView.vue:119-123,200-210).

Every submission is refused when disabled (MediaShareService.cs:69-73). !media bypasses review at RoleLevel>=10 (server/src/NomNomzBot.Infrastructure/MediaShare/Builtins/MediaBuiltin.cs:84). !play always bypasses review (Builtins/PlayBuiltin.cs:84). The passive clip scan and submit_media pass no bypass (Chat/EventHandlers/ChatMessageHandler.cs:244-246,1541; PipelineActions/SubmitMediaAction.cs:79). Auto-start needs an approved item, nothing playing and the media_share widget enabled and attached (Playback/MediaShareAutoStartHandler.cs:42-48,76-77).

media:read, media:moderate and media:write are seeded at Mod (Content/Identity/ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:536-538), and pipelines:write is seeded at Mod (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:184). Labels are at settings/permissions/i18n/en.json:248-250,320. The player is gated by can('pipelines:write') (MediaShareView.vue:148). Row actions are gated by media:moderate (components/MediaShareQueueRow.vue:101). The run route needs pipelines:write (Controllers/V1/ChannelActionRunController.cs:40). Offline, a viewer's command is blocked but mods and the broadcaster are not (Chat/OfflineCommandGate.cs:26-27; ChatMessageHandler.cs:297-299).

The debit happens at submit time after all checks and before the row is saved, including the passive path through the same SubmitAsync (MediaShareService.cs:137-163; ChatMessageHandler.cs:1541). The refund pays the current config EntryCost, is tried once, and its result is discarded (MediaShareService.cs:551-589). Reject and skip refund (MediaShareService.cs:257,282). Replay has no debit (MediaShareService.cs:330-361).

Play resumes a paused item or loads the next one (Playback/MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:119-137). Stop marks the item played and goes idle without loading the next (MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:149-161). Skip skips the item and loads the next (MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:163-174). PlayNow reorders to 1 or replays, skips the current item and loads (MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:232-267). Replay loads only when nothing is current (MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:209-230). Ended marks played and Error skips (MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:110-115). Volume is 0-100 (MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:198). Removing a played or skipped item makes it rejected, which has no controls (MediaShareService.cs:254-258; MediaShareQueueRow.vue:62,101).

reader_answers.evidence: The Settings drawer, the Accept media from viewers switch and Save settings match MediaShareView.vue:130-138 and the MediaShareSettings.vue en.json labels. The queue actions per section match MediaShareQueueRow.vue:102-170. The player controls match MediaSharePlayer.vue:162-208 and the en.json player labels.

Nothing plays without the attached media_share overlay (MediaShareAutoStartHandler.cs:48,76-77; MediaSharePlayer.vue:213-227). The four permissions default to Mod (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:184,536-538), and the player is gated by pipelines:write (MediaShareView.vue:148).

A viewer below mod who uses !media gets Pending while approval is on (MediaBuiltin.cs:84; MediaShareService.cs:137,177). Approve plus auto-start or Play loads the item (MediaShareService.cs:227-233; MediaShareAutoStartHandler.cs:42-55; MediaSharePlaybackService.cs:133). The card shows the title, sharer, Playing or Paused, and the time (MediaSharePlayer.vue:124-159).

RequireApproval defaults to true (MediaShareConfig.cs:32). The passive scan and submit_media do not bypass review (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1541; SubmitMediaAction.cs:79). Reject is offered on pending items, and Remove with its confirm dialog sends reject on approved items (MediaShareQueueRow.vue:115-148; MediaShareView.vue:114-123). RejectAsync sets Rejected and refunds unfinished items (MediaShareService.cs:254-262).
